name: Native Availability State
job: Explain and recover when the native mobile app is offline or the production server is unavailable, with a retry action.
incomingHandoff: The installed app cannot safely reach the locked BulkBite production origin because the device is offline or the server health check failed.
outgoingHandoff: A successful retry returns the user to native authentication or the current operational workspace without changing data.
responsiveBehaviour: Keep the identity, state explanation, production host, and retry action together inside the viewport and safe areas at every mobile and tablet width.

layoutContract.padding: max(var(--spacing-l), env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(var(--spacing-l), env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(var(--spacing-l), env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(var(--spacing-l), env(safe-area-inset-left))
layoutContract.containment: The state owns one viewport-contained card. Copy wraps, the action stays visible, and no child can cause page-level horizontal movement.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Availability is communicated through text and provider-native loading feedback. No decorative movement delays recovery.
